      HOURLY_SQL
      "SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM date)::int AS order_hour, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\') AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(totalPrice, 0) + COALESCE(tax, 0) + COALESCE(tip, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\'), 0) AS sales_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Return\') AS returns_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Void\') AS voids_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Discard\') AS discards_count FROM \"Order\" WHERE date >= CURRENT_DATE AND date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL \'1 day\' GROUP BY order_hour"

      private static final String
      SUMMARY_SQL
      "WITH today_orders AS (SELECT transactionType, paymentMethod, totalPrice, tax, tip FROM \"Order\" WHERE date >= CURRENT_DATE AND date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL \'1 day\'), summary AS (SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS report_date, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LOCALTIME)::int AS current_hour, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\') AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(totalPrice, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\'), 0) AS sales_subtotal, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tax, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\'), 0) AS sales_tax, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tip, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\'), 0) AS sales_tips, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(totalPrice, 0) + COALESCE(tax, 0) + COALESCE(tip, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\'), 0) AS sales_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Return\') AS returns_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(totalPrice, 0) + COALESCE(tax, 0) + COALESCE(tip, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Return\'), 0) AS returns_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Void\') AS voids_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(totalPrice, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Void\'), 0) AS voids_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Discard\') AS discards_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(totalPrice, 0)) FILTER (WHERE transactionType = \'Discard\'), 0) AS discards_total FROM today_orders), payment_totals AS (SELECT paymentMethod, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(COALESCE(totalPrice, 0) + COALESCE(tax, 0) + COALESCE(tip, 0)) AS payment_total FROM today_orders WHERE transactionType = \'Sale\' GROUP BY paymentMethod) SELECT summary.*, payment_totals.paymentMethod, payment_totals.order_count AS payment_order_count, payment_totals.payment_total FROM summary LEFT JOIN payment_totals ON TRUE ORDER BY payment_totals.paymentMethod"

      private static final String
      USAGE_SQL
      "SELECT i.id, i.name, COALESCE(SUM(u.used), 0) AS used, i.unit FROM InventoryItem i LEFT JOIN (SELECT mi.inventoryItemID, mi.amountUsed * oi.quantity * CASE WHEN ri.name = ? THEN COALESCE(s.fraction, 1) ELSE 1 END AS used FROM OrderItem oi JOIN \"Order\" o ON o.id = oi.orderID JOIN MenuItemIngredient mi ON mi.menuItemID = oi.menuItemID JOIN InventoryItem ri ON ri.id = mi.inventoryItemID LEFT JOIN (SELECT od.orderItemID, CAST(SUBSTRING(d.name FROM ?) AS NUMERIC) / 100 AS fraction FROM OrderItemDrinkOption od JOIN DrinkOptions d ON d.id = od.drinkOptionID WHERE d.name ~ ?) s ON s.orderItemID = oi.id WHERE o.transactionType <> \'Void\' AND o.date >= ? AND o.date < ? UNION ALL SELECT d.inventoryItemID, d.amountUsed * oi.quantity FROM OrderItem oi JOIN \"Order\" o ON o.id = oi.orderID JOIN OrderItemDrinkOption od ON od.orderItemID = oi.id JOIN DrinkOptions d ON d.id = od.drinkOptionID WHERE o.transactionType <> \'Void\' AND o.date >= ? AND o.date < ? AND d.inventoryItemID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT bag.id, 1 FROM \"Order\" o JOIN InventoryItem bag ON bag.name = ? WHERE o.transactionType IN (\'Sale\', \'Return\') AND o.date >= ? AND o.date < ?) u ON u.inventoryItemID = i.id GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.unit ORDER BY i.id"
